meta.title: Thinking tree
meta.description: Shows the task's chain of thought as a live tree in the right sidebar: the goal on top, the approach and technical route in the middle, concrete steps at the bottom. Every node is one Markdown file in the workspace's thinking-tree folder, so you can edit any block in the panel and the agent reads your edit before it implements. Includes a bundled skill that keeps the tree updated while it works.
